subject: 25 Salem Street LLC License Application
overview: The Medford Liquor License Commission conditionally approved a new all-alcohol restaurant license for 25 Salem Street LLC pending updated documentation. The Commission also approved a one-day alcohol license and established a Friday deadline for future meeting application submissions.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The Commission approved the minutes from the March 20, 2024 meeting.

items.title: One-Day Special Alcohol License for Event Them
items.summary: Approved a one-day beer and wine license for Event Them to host a Friends of Medford Family Network fundraiser on May 5, 2024.

items.title: All-Alcohol License Application for 25 Salem Street LLC
items.summary: Conditionally approved a new all-alcohol license and pledge of collateral for 25 Salem Street LLC, doing business as Mrs. Murphys, subject to the submission of missing financial, landlord, and application details.

items.title: Application Submission Deadline Policy
items.summary: Agreed to establish a Friday 11:00 a.m. deadline for application submissions prior to Commission meetings to comply with open meeting laws and allow adequate review time.
